description: Ed25519 on an Ed25519 key with alg EdDSA and an Ed25519 key without alg returns the key without alg; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2 (JWK alg): a member alg must equal the selector's exactly, and Ed25519 is not EdDSA; both members are Ed25519, which serves both algs (§2.1), neither has use or key_ops; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
